prompt: Illustration painted and inked BY HAND on a wood panel — visible wood grain, matte paint, and HAND-DRAWN LINE with slight natural wobble and imperfection. Loose, illustrative, storybook, NOT crisp vector, NOT digital-clean. Simple big flat shapes and generous empty space, high contrast. Palette strictly: pale bone-grey painted ground, FLAT solid black, white line, and ONE accent of glowing BIOLUMINESCENT GREEN. Beings are tiny SOLID BLACK creatures with curled spiral fiddlehead ears. NO human figures. No text, no lettering, no glyphs. A vast night landscape, hand-drawn and loose: a wide still lake in the foreground drawn with simple hand-inked ripple lines, and beyond it a range of tall jagged mountains rendered in loose black and white hatching under a flat black sky. On the near shore, tiny, a small village of cabins with glowing green windows and one standing stone with green tally marks. Two tiny black beings with spiral ears sit on the shore. A single small boat on the water. Immense scale, tiny settlement, calm empty space.
